name: What information do I need to provide for AI Market Intelligence to assess my property?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to provide for AI Market Intelligence to assess my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To effectively use AI Market Intelligence for your property assessment, you typically need to provide basic property details such as address, property type, square footage, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, and any recent upgrades. Providing accurate and complete information is a key preparation step, as the quality of the AI's output depends directly on the data it receives. This allows Kelby Contreras to generate the most precise market analysis for your specific asset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide basic property details and recent upgrades for AI Market Intelligence to assess your property accurately.
